fields.summary_ko.0: Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ: LRCX) declined 26.67% over one month due to investor reassessment amid rotation in AI-related stocks, but is up 52.62% on an annual basis, with a close of $237.50 on October 26 and market cap of $296.68B.
fields.summary_ko.1: Renaissance Large Cap Growth Strategy cited underperformance of semiconductor equipment supply stocks following reexamination of AI investment profitability, and LRCX is held in 139 hedge fund portfolios as of end of Q2.
